title: Ted Cruz vows ‘Texas will be red again’ after Democrats sweep statewide races
excerpt: U.S. Senator Ted Cruz says Texas will be red again, vowing a Republican comeback after Democrats won every statewide race in Texas in the November 3, 2026 midterm elections.
content:
U.S. Senator Ted Cruz says Texas will be red again, vowing a Republican comeback after Democrats won every statewide race in Texas in the November 3, 2026 midterm elections.

In his Verdict podcast this week, Cruz called the results a “blue tsunami” and a “Watergate-level repudiation,” saying Republicans lost every statewide race in Texas. Democrat Gina Hinojosa defeated Governor Greg Abbott, and Democrat James Talarico defeated Ken Paxton in the race for U.S. Senate.

Cruz said he is now the only statewide elected Republican remaining in Texas, and he pointed to voter frustration over the cost of living — including groceries, housing and electricity — as a driving force behind the losses.

“But hear me now: we will bring Texas back. I am filled with hope and optimism. Texas will be red again,” Cruz said on the podcast.

Cruz said Republicans must rebuild as a “true blue-collar party” and reconnect with working-class voters. He also predicted Democrats would overreach once in office, pointing to possible higher taxes and stricter energy policies.

Democrats are set to take control of the statewide offices in January 2027.

Source: Hammrod News Laredo TX, November 10, 2026. Cruz’s remarks verified against the Verdict podcast and published reports, including Texas Politics, November 6, 2026.
